name: Room timeline: thread-posts with inline turns, oldest-first

name: Post a message to the room (each new message = new thread/post)
notes: SRC. streamChat with spaceRef; gateway exchanges space_ref for a Control-signed thread-create decision. Every post is a Model Plane invocation.

name: Human-only message (post without an AI reply)

Doc says the human-only flow continues when no agent is called, which is a doc-vs-code discrepancy.
